answer: Proposed prism-calibration market for lagoon and summit sensors: each ID/day burns 1 fixed-supply token and obtains customer-signed acceptance of an assigned job. A contract checks the burn and receipt against ID/day/job and rejects reuse; failure denies listing. Ten IDs burn ten tokens/day despite shared rigs or parallel jobs. Burns are nonrefundable recurring expense; rigs are reusable capital; no stake. Customer collusion can fake service, and low token value makes identities cheap. This prices accounts, not unique owners.
